projects.title: PairCheck - Image-Text Mismatch Detection
projects.description: Built a lightweight machine-learning pipeline to identify images paired with captions that misrepresent their content.
highlights: Combined frozen CLIP/OpenCLIP image and text embeddings with a trainable PyTorch classification head to detect image-caption mismatches.
Prepared training, validation, and test sets from COCO image-caption data, splitting by image so no image appeared in more than one set.

Generated semantic hard negatives with an LLM across nine perturbation types: replace_object, replace_attribute, replace_relation, swap_object, swap_attribute, add_object, add_attribute, replace_action, and replace_count.
Used balanced minibatches for training and validation-based model selection.
Evaluated an OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 baseline on SugarCrepe, achieving 76.55% pairwise accuracy.

projects.title: LLM Agent Trace Analyzer
projects.description: Designed a trace-analysis workflow for an AI test-generation agent to uncover agent failures and enable root-cause analysis.
highlights: Defined trace-level and span-level issue labels as part of the Huawei university collaboration, covering instruction violations, tool misuse, unproductive loops, task/output divergence, and likely failure causes.
Implemented analyzers for planning, instruction following, tool use, and root-cause aggregation.
Combined rule-based and LLM-based assessments of agent behavior using self-hosted Langfuse traces.

projects.title: SaliencyMix Replication
projects.description: Implemented core components of SaliencyMix, a saliency-based image-augmentation method, along with ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ResNet-101 in PyTorch. Built saliency-map generation and image-region mixing for classification workflows.
highlights: Implemented core components of SaliencyMix, the saliency-based image-augmentation technique presented at ICLR 2021.
Implemented ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ResNet-101 in PyTorch.
Generated saliency maps and mixed salient image regions for image-classification workflows.
Reproduced all experiments with a complete training and evaluation pipeline.
Worked with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet datasets.

projects.title: DeObfus Email
projects.description: Built a cross-browser extension that converts obfuscated email text into clean, copy-ready addresses. Implemented rule-based parsing for varied masking formats and handled Firefox/Chromium API and permission differences.
highlights: Converted obfuscated email text into clean, copy-ready email addresses.
Implemented rule-based parsing for varied masking templates, mixed symbols, and edge cases.
Handled API and permission differences between Firefox and Chromium, including Manifest V3.

projects.title: HF ML App Analysis
projects.description: Collected and filtered applications built on top-downloaded Hugging Face text-classification and text-generation models. Extracted code-size metrics with Lizard and analyzed implementation-size and maintainability trends using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
highlights: Studied implementation size and maintainability characteristics of Hugging Face text-classification and text-generation applications.
Selected the top 20 models by downloads, collected applications using them, and filtered repositories using defined selection criteria.
Used Lizard to extract non-comment lines of code (NLOC), then analyzed trends with Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
